items.title: 68002_Benny Waters oral history interview
items.q: Carney was going to the New England Conservatory. He left the New England Conservatory to come to me.

ctx.x: How did he find you, through the radio or through your brother?
No, from the radio. Carney was going to the New England Conservatory. He left the New England Conservatory to come to me.
Were you at the New England Conservatory, or you left, too?
